note: Fixture month for the WSH digest (spec 47). Four pages: in-scope fatality, heat-stress circular, CSRA Energy Wheel paper, out-of-scope fatality.

signals.title: Worker killed after fall from height at Singapore construction worksite
signals.text: The Ministry of Manpower said a construction worker died after a fall from height at a worksite in Singapore on 18 October 2026. Investigations are ongoing. No investigation findings or lessons learnt have been published yet.

signals.title: WSH Council circular on heat stress measures for outdoor work in Singapore
signals.text: The Workplace Safety and Health Council issued a circular on heat stress guidelines for outdoor work in Singapore, including rest cycles and hydration. The circular updates guidance for employers.

signals.title: Construction Safety Research Alliance updates Energy Wheel for hazard recognition
signals.text: Dr Matthew Hallowell and the Construction Safety Research Alliance describe the Energy Wheel for hazard recognition and note HECA direct controls. The paper does not report a Singapore incident.

signals.title: Construction worker killed after fall from height at Texas worksite
signals.text: A construction worker was killed after a fall from height at a worksite in Texas. Authorities opened an investigation.
